'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Jonny Chu LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet '''Johnny Chu''' / deck '''The Old Man At Work'''; dest [[Jonny Chu]]. Hidden Base systems also noted in ADDITIONAL.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
